alignment_bytes.note: Payload sections of envelope binaries start on this boundary.

angle_direction.note: A positive angle turns clockwise as seen on the page (y down).

char_pitch_units_per_point.note: Unit of a document grid's `charSpace`: 1/4096 point.

color_model.note: A colour is [red, green, blue], sRGB (IEC 61966-2-1), no alpha.

column_break_char.note: U+000E in a paragraph's text is a column break.

coordinate_origin.note: Offsets, drawing items and pixels are measured from the top-left corner.

date_format.note: Dates and times are ISO 8601 text (2026-03-01T10:15:00Z).

emu_per_inch.note: The one EMU-valued field: a text box story's `textBody.inset`.

endianness.note: Every envelope binary is little-endian. MessagePack header integers inside an envelope are big-endian by MessagePack's own definition (spec/layouts/ENVELOPE.layout.txt section 4).

hash_algorithm.note: Every files[].sha256, every input_hash, license.sha256, and spec_sha256.

image_bit_depth.note: A rendition and the page preview are 8 bits per channel RGBA; an original PNG is whatever its own header says.

image_color_space.note: Renditions and the preview are sRGB; an original PNG's own colour chunks win.

length_unit.note: Every length is in points unless its schema description names another unit.

line_break_char.note: U+000A in a paragraph's text is a manual line break within the paragraph.

line_ending.note: The plain-text derivative ends every paragraph and table row with U+000A.

nonbreaking_hyphen_char.note: U+2011 is a hyphen no line breaks at.

nonbreaking_space_char.note: U+00A0 is a space no line breaks at.

number_precision.note: Non-integer numbers are IEEE 754 binary32 values written in the shortest decimal form that reads back to the same binary32 (chart values: binary64).

object_char.note: U+FFFC in a paragraph's text marks an inline object: the k-th one is objects[k].

page_break_char.note: U+000C in a paragraph's text is a page break.

percent_scale.note: A value described as a percentage runs 0..100 (not 0..1), unless its description says fraction.

preview_pixels_per_point.note: The page preview is rendered at 1 pixel per point (72 dpi): a US Letter page is 612 x 792 pixels.

signature_algorithm.note: SIGNATURE.json only. Refusing it is the 'unverified' state, not damage.

soft_hyphen_char.note: U+00AD is an optional hyphen: shown only where a line breaks at it.

tab_char.note: U+0009 in a paragraph's text is a tab.

text_encoding.note: Every text and JSON payload, INCLUDING MANIFEST.json - which is why the scope is container.

text_normalization.note: Text is stored as authored; no Unicode normalisation is applied or assumed.

text_offset_unit.note: A run's `len` counts bytes of the paragraph text's UTF-8 encoding.

wrap_polygon_extent.note: A wrap polygon's coordinate space: 21600 units span the object's width, and its height.

note: The machine-readable convention to node-type map of profile rich-document/1 (SPEC.md section 10.2, ruling S-17). The convention set is a property of the PROFILE, not of the reader (S-25): check these and no others.
